name: shrinkfit
description: Shrink JSON/YAML payloads to fit a character budget while preserving their schema and structure

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p shrinkfit-ffi --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml && mkdir -p dist && cp ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/shrinkfit.wasm dist/
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
